newsitem.title: FRANCE: British Airways unit to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: British Airways unit to hold news conference.

text.p: British Airways Plc (BA) said the chairman of its French subsidiary TAT European Airlines, Marc Rochet, would hold a news conference later on Monday at 1500 GMT concerning the Air Liberte airline.
BA has said it is interested in buying Air Liberte, which filed for insolvency protection on September 26. BA would win valuable landing slots at Paris Orly airport if it bought Air Liberte.
French travel agency Nouvelles Frontieres has emerged as a possible bidder for Air Liberte, according to the Le Monde newspaper.
AOM, owned by the CDR holding company selling off assets of distressed Credit Lyonnais bank, is also reported to be chasing Air Liberte.
BA has asked the European Commission to block any AOM bid on the view that it would be in breach of conditions agreed for state aid for Credit Lyonnais.
